small_scratch_test.definition: Scratch annotation box <=1% of image area; not a physical width measurement

decision: Rejected for live deployment: small-scratch performance worsened and absolute precision/recall are inadequate. Existing live detector retained.
metric_note: Ultralytics precision/recall are measured at its selected F1 operating point, not calibrated certainty or production confidence. Dataset has broad and automatic labels and lacks some app damage classes; these are pilot results only.
checkpoint_location: Colab runtime /content/ballighni-training/runs/scratch_finetune/weights/best.pt; results download cells provided in notebook. No checkpoint deployed.
